## 9 Element 07's one route: an employee claims one order, and leaves with the claim or with the refusal.

A granted claim is 201 — a claim is a fact that did not exist before, and one claim emits one event (RULE-8). A repeated claim by the same employee answers 200 with the same state (element 11 D-11-2). The refusal is not built here: the aggregate raises it and the one advice answers 409 with the guard's own reason. The request takes no body on purpose — the claimer is the assignee, so the assignee is the caller's own identity read from the token (RULE-5). The empty command record keeps the route a command and keeps the body optional.

Method and path
: `POST` `/processing/{processingId}/assignment`

Authentication
: `bearer JWT`
